Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 336 as introduced provides for the certification of residential plumbers and gas fitters by Alabama Plumbers an Gas Fitters Examining Board which would increase the obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of newly certified residential plumbers/gas fitters. This increase could be offset, wholly or in part, presumably by an application fee, certification fee, exam fee or renewal fee established by the Board pursuant to this bill. The Board estimates 4,000 current master plumbers/gas fitters and 2,000 current journeyman plumbers/gas fitters would apply for the residential plumbers/gas fitters' certificate, in the first year, which could increase or decrease receipts to the state Plumbers and Gas Fitters Examining Board by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the certification fees set by the Board for these new certifications and current certification fees paid by existing plumbers/gas fitters.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/02/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 336 as substituted and reported by the Committee on Boards, Agencies and Commissions would add two members to the Alabama Plumbers and Gas Fitters Examining Board which would increase the obligations of the Board by an estimated $720 per meeting.
Further, this bill could increase the obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount to allow the Board to adopt rules regarding continuing education requirements. These obligations could be offset, wholly or in part, by fees levied and collected for continuing education, as provided by this bill.
Finally, this bill requires a certificate holder subject to disciplinary action to satisfy all fines, fees, and restitution prior to recertification, which could increase receipts to the Board by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any such fine or fees that otherwise not have been paid.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions
